quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 2025: revenue JPY 991,385 million, down 0.7%; operating profit JPY 41,945 million, up 10.7% (margin 4.2%); profit before tax JPY 67,950 million, up 31.1%; profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 55,540 million, up 53.9%. Management states demand rose mainly for AI in its main semiconductor and information and communications markets, but the market as a whole had not fully recovered; Core Components revenue rose, led by semiconductor-related components, while Electronic Components and Solutions revenue fell mainly on the stronger yen. Profit improvement of about JPY 12.0 billion in the semiconductor components organic materials business and the Kyocera AVX Components group outweighed a decline of about JPY 8.0 billion in Kyocera's electronic components and document solutions businesses.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 991,385 million (-0.7%); operating profit JPY 41,945 million (+10.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: Core Components segment, first half to September 2025: revenue JPY 307,658 million, up 4.6%; business profit JPY 30,020 million, up 76.1% (margin 9.8%). Semiconductor-Related Components revenue JPY 162,656 million, up 7.2%, with profit of JPY 17,628 million, up 212.9% (margin 10.8%). Management states revenue grew mainly on higher sales of automotive camera modules, ceramic packages for the information and communications market and organic packages for data centers, and profit also benefited from structural reform in the semiconductor components organic materials business.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor-Related Components H1 revenue JPY 162,656 million (+7.2%), profit JPY 17,628 million (+212.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Orders received, first half to September 2025: total JPY 1,019,064 million, down 0.2%; Core Components JPY 307,569 million, up 2.0%, of which Semiconductor-Related Components JPY 161,037 million, up 10.4%, and Industrial and Automotive Components JPY 134,383 million, down 6.6%; Electronic Components JPY 180,774 million, down 0.3%.
